_comment: Guided tour of the Agent panel. Targets are the item_rects ChatApp records when opened as the agent plugin; awaited steps wait for the user's own press.

steps.title: ChiSurf in plain words
steps.text: Ask for an analysis the way you would ask a colleague. The agent runs ChiSurf's tools on the loaded data and shows every step it takes.

steps.title: Choose a provider
steps.text: The model that answers. The dot beside it is green when the provider is configured; hover it to see what is missing.

steps.title: Provider settings
steps.text: Endpoint, key and model of the selected provider. The key is kept in your settings store and never written into a project.

steps.title: What the agent may do
steps.text: The mode limits the tools: reading only, running analyses, or also executing code it writes.

steps.title: Start from an example
steps.text: 💡 Things to ask lists prompts that ship with ChiSurf. Picking one puts it in the input box for you to edit.

await.hint: Pick an example from 💡 Things to ask.

steps.title: Send the request
steps.text: Edit the request if you like, then press Send. If a choice is open, the agent asks first; answer in the same box.

steps.title: Read what it did
steps.text: Every tool call is a badge here: [ok] done, [x] failed. Click a badge to see its input and result; the last message states the numbers and the assumptions behind them.
